tribal_context: Kentucky tribal nations and urban Indian programs

tribal_entities.region: North Carolina (ancestral homeland adjacent to Eastern Kentucky)
tribal_entities.jurisdiction_notes: Kentucky has no federally recognized tribes with reservation land within state borders. Enrolled members of federally recognized tribes (primarily Cherokee, Shawnee, and others from surrounding states) reside in Kentucky as urban AI/AN residents. ICWA applies for any child welfare matter involving enrolled members regardless of residence.

activation_steps: Apply federal ICWA standards per 25 U.S.C. §§ 1901-1963
